convert_bigbird_pegasus_ckpt_to_pytorch: convert a BigBird Pegasus TensorFlow checkpoint to a PyTorch model and save it to a directory
convert_bigbird_pegasus: convert a dictionary of TensorFlow weights into a BigBird Pegasus PyTorch model with a config update
get_tf_weights_as_numpy: load TensorFlow checkpoint variables from a directory into a dictionary of numpy arrays
rename_state_dict_key: rename a TensorFlow weight key to a Hugging Face PyTorch key using a list of pattern pairs
run_bigbird_pegasus_conversion_cli: run the BigBird Pegasus TF-to-PyTorch conversion script from the command line with ckpt and save paths
